//! Native, bounded building blocks for the inactive netmk Phase 1 runit graph.
//!
//! This binary never activates services. It owns only the declared netmk
//! attachment, feature policy rules/route, feature-cookie flows, and
//! authenticated adapter checks.

use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use op_grpc_bridge::grpc_client::DEFAULT_NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR;
use op_grpc_bridge::{GrpcClientPool, RemoteOperationClient};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::incus::IncusPlugin;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::oci::{
    GrpcAdapterConfig, OciContainerConfig, OciPlugin, PortAttachConfig,
};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::openflow::{FlowAction, FlowEntry, OpenFlowPlugin};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::process::Command;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

const COOKIE_PREFIX: u64 = 0x4e4d4b0000000000;
const COOKIE_MASK: u64 = 0xffffff0000000000;
const BRIDGE: &str = "ovsbr0";
const PORT: &str = "netmk";
const HOST_INSIDE: &str = "svc0";
const XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS: &str = "10.200.0.1";
const XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS: &str = "10.200.1.2";
const FEATURE_SOURCE: &str = "10.200.1.1";

fn env_or(name: &str, default: &str) -> String {
    std::env::var(name).unwrap_or_else(|_| default.to_string())
}

fn is_already_exists(error: &anyhow::Error) -> bool {
    let text = format!("{error:#}").to_ascii_lowercase();
    text.contains("file exists") || text.contains("eexist") || text.contains("os error 17")
}

fn netmaker_attachment() -> OciContainerConfig {
    OciContainerConfig {
        name: env_or("NETMAKER_INSTANCE", "netmaker"),
        loopback_required: true,
        port_attach: Some(PortAttachConfig {
            bridge: BRIDGE.to_string(),
            port_name: PORT.to_string(),
            ip_addrs: vec![format!("{FEATURE_SOURCE}/30")],
            gateway: XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS.to_string(),
            routes: Vec::new(),
        }),
        grpc_adapter: Some(GrpcAdapterConfig {
            binary: "op-grpc-adapters".to_string(),
            socket: "/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/netmaker/op-grpc-adapters.sock".to_string(),
            host_endpoint: DEFAULT_NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR.to_string(),
        }),
        supervision: Some("runit".to_string()),
        ..OciContainerConfig::default()
    }
}

async fn attachment(command: &str) -> Result<()> {
    let plugin = OciPlugin::new();
    let desired = netmaker_attachment();
    match command {
        "reconcile" => {
            for change in plugin.reconcile_container_attachment(&desired).await? {
                println!("{change}");
            }
            if !plugin.verify_container_attachment(&desired).await? {
                bail!("netmaker attachment did not pass independent verification");
            }
        }
        "verify" => {
            if !plugin.verify_container_attachment(&desired).await? {
                bail!("netmaker attachment is not ready");
            }
        }
        "teardown" => plugin.delete_container_attachment(&desired).await?,
        other => bail!("unknown attachment action '{other}'"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

async fn discover_xray_inside(pid: u32) -> Result<String> {
    let interfaces = op_network::rtnetlink::in_network_namespace(pid, || async {
        op_network::rtnetlink::list_interfaces().await
    })
    .await?;
    interfaces
        .into_iter()
        .find(|interface| {
            interface.name != "lo"
                && interface.addresses.iter().any(|address| {
                    address.family == "inet" && address.address == XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS
                })
        })
        .map(|interface| interface.name)
        .with_context(|| {
            format!(
                "no xray inside interface carries required existing address {XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS}"
            )
        })
}

async fn host_return_route_ready() -> Result<bool> {
    let routes = op_network::rtnetlink::list_routes_for_interface(HOST_INSIDE).await?;
    Ok(routes.iter().any(|route| {
        route.get("destination").and_then(|value| value.as_str()) == Some("10.200.1.0/30")
            && route.get("gateway").and_then(|value| value.as_str()) == Some(XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS)
            && route.get("table").and_then(|value| value.as_u64()) == Some(254)
    }))
}

async fn egress_network_ready() -> Result<bool> {
    let xray_name = env_or("XRAY_INSTANCE", "xray");
    let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
    let inside = discover_xray_inside(pid).await?;
    let interfaces = op_network::rtnetlink::in_network_namespace(pid, move || async move {
        op_network::rtnetlink::list_interfaces().await
    })
    .await?;
    let address_ready = interfaces.iter().any(|interface| {
        interface.name == inside
            && interface.addresses.iter().any(|address| {
                address.family == "inet"
                    && address.address == XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS
                    && address.prefix_len == 30
            })
    });
    Ok(address_ready
        && host_return_route_ready().await?
        && op_network::rtnetlink::verify_netmk_policy_rules().await?)
}

async fn egress_network(command: &str) -> Result<()> {
    match command {
        "reconcile" => {
            let xray_name = env_or("XRAY_INSTANCE", "xray");
            let initial_pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
            let inside = discover_xray_inside(initial_pid).await?;
            if let Err(error) = op_network::rtnetlink::add_ipv4_address_in_netns(
                initial_pid,
                &inside,
                XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS,
                30,
            )
            .await
            {
                if !is_already_exists(&error) {
                    return Err(error).context("add xray netmk gateway address");
                }
            }
            let current_pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
            if current_pid != initial_pid {
                bail!(
                    "xray restarted during reconciliation (PID {initial_pid} -> {current_pid}); retry"
                );
            }
            if !host_return_route_ready().await? {
                if let Err(error) = op_network::rtnetlink::add_ipv4_route(
                    "10.200.1.0/30",
                    Some(XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS),
                    HOST_INSIDE,
                    Some(254),
                )
                .await
                {
                    if !is_already_exists(&error) {
                        return Err(error).context("add feature host return route");
                    }
                }
            }
            op_network::rtnetlink::reconcile_netmk_policy_rules().await?;
            if !egress_network_ready().await? {
                bail!("native xray/host route and policy-rule verification failed");
            }
            println!("xray_inside={inside}");
            println!("xray_pid={current_pid}");
        }
        "inspect" => {
            let xray_name = env_or("XRAY_INSTANCE", "xray");
            let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
            let inside = discover_xray_inside(pid).await?;
            println!("xray_inside={inside}");
            println!("xray_pid={pid}");
        }
        "verify" => {
            if !egress_network_ready().await? {
                bail!("native xray/host egress integration is not ready");
            }
        }
        "teardown" => {
            op_network::rtnetlink::delete_netmk_policy_rules().await?;
            op_network::rtnetlink::delete_ipv4_route(
                "10.200.1.0/30",
                Some(XRAY_EXISTING_ADDRESS),
                HOST_INSIDE,
                Some(254),
            )
            .await?;
            let xray_name = env_or("XRAY_INSTANCE", "xray");
            let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&xray_name).await?;
            let inside = discover_xray_inside(pid).await?;
            op_network::rtnetlink::del_ipv4_address_in_netns(pid, &inside, XRAY_NETMK_ADDRESS, 30)
                .await?;
        }
        other => bail!("unknown egress-network action '{other}'"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn parse_ports(values: &[String]) -> Result<Vec<u16>> {
    if values.is_empty() {
        bail!("at least one approved UDP destination port is required");
    }
    let mut seen = HashSet::new();
    let mut ports = Vec::new();
    for value in values {
        let port: u16 = value
            .parse()
            .with_context(|| format!("invalid UDP destination port '{value}'"))?;
        if port == 0 {
            bail!("UDP destination port must be between 1 and 65535");
        }
        if seen.insert(port) {
            ports.push(port);
        }
    }
    ports.sort_unstable();
    Ok(ports)
}

fn desired_flows(ports: &[u16]) -> Vec<FlowEntry> {
    let mut flows = vec![FlowEntry {
        table: 0,
        priority: 100,
        match_fields: HashMap::from([
            ("in_port".to_string(), PORT.to_string()),
            ("arp".to_string(), String::new()),
        ]),
        actions: vec![FlowAction::Normal],
        cookie: Some(COOKIE_PREFIX | 0x01),
        idle_timeout: 0,
        hard_timeout: 0,
    }];
    for port in ports {
        flows.push(FlowEntry {
            table: 0,
            priority: 100,
            match_fields: HashMap::from([
                ("in_port".to_string(), PORT.to_string()),
                ("udp".to_string(), String::new()),
                ("tp_dst".to_string(), port.to_string()),
            ]),
            actions: vec![FlowAction::Normal],
            cookie: Some(COOKIE_PREFIX | 0x10000 | u64::from(*port)),
            idle_timeout: 0,
            hard_timeout: 0,
        });
    }
    flows.push(FlowEntry {
        table: 0,
        priority: 50,
        match_fields: HashMap::from([("in_port".to_string(), PORT.to_string())]),
        actions: vec![FlowAction::Drop],
        cookie: Some(COOKIE_PREFIX | 0xff),
        idle_timeout: 0,
        hard_timeout: 0,
    });
    flows
}

async fn openflow(command: &str, port_args: &[String]) -> Result<()> {
    let plugin = OpenFlowPlugin::new();
    match command {
        "reconcile" | "verify" => {
            let ports = parse_ports(port_args)?;
            let desired = desired_flows(&ports);
            if command == "reconcile" {
                for change in plugin
                    .reconcile_cookie_scoped(BRIDGE, &desired, COOKIE_PREFIX, COOKIE_MASK)
                    .await?
                {
                    println!("{change}");
                }
            }
            if !plugin
                .verify_cookie_scoped(BRIDGE, &desired, COOKIE_PREFIX, COOKIE_MASK)
                .await?
            {
                bail!("authoritative feature-cookie OpenFlow verification failed");
            }
        }
        "teardown" => {
            let deleted = plugin
                .clear_cookie_scoped(BRIDGE, COOKIE_PREFIX, COOKIE_MASK)
                .await?;
            println!("deleted_flows={deleted}");
        }
        other => bail!("unknown openflow action '{other}'"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn adapter_client() -> RemoteOperationClient {
    let endpoint = env_or("NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR", DEFAULT_NETMAKER_ADAPTER_ADDR);
    RemoteOperationClient::new_with_netmaker_address(
        Arc::new(GrpcClientPool::new()),
        "http://127.0.0.1:8090",
        &endpoint,
        "op-netmk-reconcile",
    )
}

async fn adapter_health() -> Result<()> {
    let health = adapter_client().netmaker_health().await?;
    let status = health.status.to_ascii_lowercase();
    if !matches!(status.as_str(), "ok" | "healthy" | "running" | "success") {
        bail!(
            "Netmaker adapter returned unhealthy status {:?}",
            health.status
        );
    }
    println!("status={}", health.status);
    println!("version={}", health.version);
    Ok(())
}

fn endpoint_port(value: &str) -> Result<Option<u16>> {
    if value == "(none)" {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let port_text = value
        .rsplit_once(':')
        .map(|(_, port)| port)
        .with_context(|| format!("WireGuard endpoint has no port: {value}"))?;
    let port: u16 = port_text
        .parse()
        .with_context(|| format!("invalid WireGuard endpoint port '{port_text}'"))?;
    if port == 0 {
        bail!("WireGuard endpoint port must be non-zero");
    }
    Ok(Some(port))
}

async fn discover_netclient_ports() -> Result<Vec<u16>> {
    let name = env_or("NETMAKER_INSTANCE", "netmaker");
    let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&name).await?;
    op_network::rtnetlink::in_network_namespace(pid, move || async move {
        let mut ports = HashSet::new();
        for query in [["show", "all", "listen-port"], ["show", "all", "endpoints"]] {
            let output = Command::new("/usr/bin/wg")
                .args(query)
                .output()
                .with_context(|| format!("execute /usr/bin/wg {}", query.join(" ")))?;
            if !output.status.success() {
                bail!(
                    "wg {} failed: {}",
                    query.join(" "),
                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
                );
            }
            for line in String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).lines() {
                let Some(value) = line.split_whitespace().last() else {
                    continue;
                };
                let port = if query[2] == "listen-port" {
                    let port: u16 = value
                        .parse()
                        .with_context(|| format!("invalid WireGuard listen port '{value}'"))?;
                    if port == 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    port
                } else {
                    let Some(port) = endpoint_port(value)? else {
                        continue;
                    };
                    port
                };
                ports.insert(port);
            }
        }
        let mut ports: Vec<_> = ports.into_iter().collect();
        ports.sort_unstable();
        if ports.is_empty() {
            bail!("no Netclient WireGuard listen or peer endpoint ports discovered");
        }
        Ok(ports)
    })
    .await
}

async fn recent_netclient_handshake(max_age_seconds: u64) -> Result<bool> {
    let name = env_or("NETMAKER_INSTANCE", "netmaker");
    let pid = IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(&name).await?;
    op_network::rtnetlink::in_network_namespace(pid, move || async move {
        let output = Command::new("/usr/bin/wg")
            .args(["show", "all", "latest-handshakes"])
            .output()
            .context("execute /usr/bin/wg in netmaker network namespace")?;
        if !output.status.success() {
            bail!(
                "wg show failed: {}",
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
            );
        }
        let now = SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .context("system clock before UNIX epoch")?
            .as_secs();
        for line in String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).lines() {
            let timestamp = line
                .split_whitespace()
                .last()
                .and_then(|value| value.parse::<u64>().ok())
                .unwrap_or(0);
            if timestamp > 0 && now.saturating_sub(timestamp) <= max_age_seconds {
                return Ok(true);
            }
        }
        Ok(false)
    })
    .await
}

async fn netclient(command: &str, max_age: Option<&String>) -> Result<()> {
    match command {
        "restart" => {
            if !adapter_client().netmaker_restart("netclient").await? {
                bail!("adapter reported netclient restart failure");
            }
        }
        "health" => {
            adapter_health().await?;
            let list = adapter_client().netclient_list().await?;
            if !list.success {
                bail!("netclient list failed: {}", list.stderr.trim());
            }
            let max_age = max_age
                .map(|value| value.parse::<u64>())
                .transpose()
                .context("invalid maximum handshake age")?
                .unwrap_or(180);
            if !recent_netclient_handshake(max_age).await? {
                bail!("no netclient WireGuard handshake within {max_age} seconds");
            }
        }
        other => bail!("unknown netclient action '{other}'"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn usage() -> ! {
    eprintln!(
        "usage: op-netmk-reconcile \
         attachment <reconcile|verify|teardown> | \
         egress-network <reconcile|inspect|verify|teardown> | \
         openflow <reconcile|verify|teardown> [UDP_PORT ...] | \
         adapter-health | peer-ports | netclient <restart|health> [MAX_HANDSHAKE_AGE] | \
         instance-pid <NAME>"
    );
    std::process::exit(2)
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    match args.as_slice() {
        [group, action] if group == "attachment" => attachment(action).await,
        [group, action] if group == "egress-network" => egress_network(action).await,
        [group, action, ports @ ..] if group == "openflow" => openflow(action, ports).await,
        [command] if command == "adapter-health" => adapter_health().await,
        [command] if command == "peer-ports" => {
            for port in discover_netclient_ports().await? {
                println!("{port}");
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        [group, action] if group == "netclient" => netclient(action, None).await,
        [group, action, max_age] if group == "netclient" => netclient(action, Some(max_age)).await,
        [command, name] if command == "instance-pid" => {
            println!("{}", IncusPlugin::resolve_instance_pid(name).await?);
            Ok(())
        }
        _ => usage(),
    }
}

//! Rtnetlink state plugin - manages kernel-level network interface state
//!
//! Handles: IP addresses, link state (up/down), MAC addresses, default routes
//! Uses native rtnetlink (netlink) protocol — no CLI wrappers.
//! Depends on: net, ovsdb_bridge (interfaces must exist before configuring)

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{
    ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateAction, StateDiff, StatePlugin,
};
use op_state_store::{FieldSchema, FieldType, PluginSchema};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::{json, OwnedValue as Value};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Rtnetlink interface configuration
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct RtnetlinkInterfaceConfig {
    /// Interface name (e.g., "ens3", "ovsbr0-int")
    pub name: String,

    /// Optional current container init PID whose network namespace owns the interface.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub netns_pid: Option<u32>,

    /// IPv4/IPv6 addresses to assign
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub addresses: Option<Vec<AddressEntry>>,

    /// MAC address to set (e.g., "fa:16:3e:f1:71:d2")
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub mac_address: Option<String>,

    /// MTU
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub mtu: Option<u32>,

    /// Desired link state: "up" or "down"
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub state: Option<String>,

    /// Default gateway (only one interface should set this)
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub default_gateway: Option<String>,
}

/// IP address entry
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct AddressEntry {
    pub ip: String,
    pub prefix: u8,
}

/// Rtnetlink state — list of managed interfaces
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct RtnetlinkState {
    pub interfaces: Vec<RtnetlinkInterfaceConfig>,
}

pub struct RtnetlinkPlugin;

impl RtnetlinkPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl Default for RtnetlinkPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for RtnetlinkPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "rtnetlink"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "1.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<op_state_store::PluginSchema> {
        Some(rtnetlink_schema())
    }

    fn is_available(&self) -> bool {
        // rtnetlink is always available — it's the kernel
        true
    }

    fn unavailable_reason(&self) -> String {
        "rtnetlink is always available".to_string()
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, current: &Value, desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        let current_state: RtnetlinkState = simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(current.clone())
            .unwrap_or(RtnetlinkState { interfaces: vec![] });
        let desired_state: RtnetlinkState = simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(desired.clone())
            .unwrap_or(RtnetlinkState { interfaces: vec![] });

        let mut actions = Vec::new();

        let current_map: HashMap<&str, &RtnetlinkInterfaceConfig> = current_state
            .interfaces
            .iter()
            .map(|i| (i.name.as_str(), i))
            .collect();

        for desired_iface in &desired_state.interfaces {
            if let Some(current_iface) = current_map.get(desired_iface.name.as_str()) {
                // Check if any property differs
                let needs_update = desired_iface.state != current_iface.state
                    || desired_iface.mac_address != current_iface.mac_address
                    || desired_iface.addresses != current_iface.addresses
                    || desired_iface.default_gateway.is_some();

                if needs_update {
                    actions.push(StateAction::Modify {
                        resource: desired_iface.name.clone(),
                        changes: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(desired_iface)?,
                    });
                }
            } else {
                // Interface not found in kernel — can only configure if it exists
                log::warn!(
                    "rtnetlink: desired interface '{}' not found in kernel",
                    desired_iface.name
                );
            }
        }

        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions,
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(current)?)),
                desired_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(desired)?)),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        let mut changes_applied = Vec::new();
        let mut errors = Vec::new();

        for action in &diff.actions {
            if let StateAction::Modify { resource, changes } = action {
                let config: RtnetlinkInterfaceConfig =
                    simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(changes.clone())?;

                // Set MAC address
                if let Some(ref mac) = config.mac_address {
                    let result = if let Some(pid) = config.netns_pid {
                        op_network::rtnetlink::set_mac_address_in_netns(pid, resource, mac).await
                    } else {
                        op_network::rtnetlink::set_mac_address(resource, mac).await
                    };
                    match result {
                        Ok(_) => changes_applied
                            .push(format!("Set MAC {} on {} via rtnetlink", mac, resource)),
                        Err(e) => errors.push(format!("Failed to set MAC on {}: {}", resource, e)),
                    }
                }

                // Add IP addresses
                if let Some(ref addresses) = config.addresses {
                    for addr in addresses {
                        let result = if let Some(pid) = config.netns_pid {
                            op_network::rtnetlink::add_ipv4_address_in_netns(
                                pid,
                                resource,
                                &addr.ip,
                                addr.prefix,
                            )
                            .await
                        } else {
                            op_network::rtnetlink::add_ipv4_address(resource, &addr.ip, addr.prefix)
                                .await
                        };
                        match result {
                            Ok(_) => changes_applied.push(format!(
                                "Added {}/{} to {} via rtnetlink",
                                addr.ip, addr.prefix, resource
                            )),
                            Err(e) => {
                                // EEXIST is not an error — address already assigned
                                let msg = e.to_string();
                                if msg.contains("exist") {
                                    log::info!(
                                        "Address {}/{} already on {} (ok)",
                                        addr.ip,
                                        addr.prefix,
                                        resource
                                    );
                                } else {
                                    errors.push(format!(
                                        "Failed to add {}/{} to {}: {}",
                                        addr.ip, addr.prefix, resource, e
                                    ));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Set link state
                if let Some(ref state) = config.state {
                    let result = if let Some(pid) = config.netns_pid {
                        op_network::rtnetlink::set_link_state_in_netns(pid, resource, state == "up")
                            .await
                    } else if state == "up" {
                        op_network::rtnetlink::link_up(resource).await
                    } else {
                        op_network::rtnetlink::link_down(resource).await
                    };
                    match result {
                        Ok(_) => changes_applied
                            .push(format!("Set {} {} via rtnetlink", resource, state)),
                        Err(e) => {
                            errors.push(format!("Failed to set {} {}: {}", resource, state, e))
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Set default gateway
                if let Some(ref gateway) = config.default_gateway {
                    let result = if let Some(pid) = config.netns_pid {
                        op_network::rtnetlink::add_default_route_in_netns(pid, resource, gateway)
                            .await
                    } else {
                        op_network::rtnetlink::add_default_route(resource, gateway).await
                    };
                    match result {
                        Ok(_) => changes_applied.push(format!(
                            "Set default route via {} on {} via rtnetlink",
                            gateway, resource
                        )),
                        Err(e) if e.to_string().to_ascii_lowercase().contains("exist") => {
                            log::info!(
                                "Default route via {} on {} already exists (ok)",
                                gateway,
                                resource
                            );
                        }
                        Err(e) => errors.push(format!(
                            "Failed to set default route via {}: {}",
                            gateway, e
                        )),
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: errors.is_empty(),
            changes_applied,
            errors,
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        let state = simd_json::json!(null);
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: format!("rtnetlink-{}", chrono::Utc::now().timestamp()),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: state,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        let old_state: RtnetlinkState =
            simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(checkpoint.state_snapshot.clone())?;

        // Re-apply old state
        let current = simd_json::json!(null);
        let diff = self
            .calculate_diff(&current, &simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&old_state)?)
            .await?;
        self.apply_state(&diff).await?;

        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: true,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,

/// `zeroclaw::dispatch_zeroclaw_method`'s role — the plugin crate owns its

/// Map a raw Netmaker API network object onto the typed [`NetworkSummary`].
fn network_summary_from_api(v: &JsonValue) -> NetworkSummary {
    let s = |k: &str| v.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let i = |k: &str| v.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_i64()).unwrap_or(0);
    NetworkSummary {
        netid: s("netid"),
        address_range: s("addressrange"),
        address_range6: s("addressrange6"),
        default_mtu: i("defaultmtu"),
        default_keepalive: i("defaultkeepalive"),
    }
}

/// Map a raw Netmaker API node object onto the typed [`NodeSummary`].
fn node_summary_from_api(v: &JsonValue) -> NodeSummary {
    let s = |k: &str| v.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let b = |k: &str| v.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false);
    NodeSummary {
        id: s("id"),
        host_id: s("hostid"),
        network: s("network"),
        address: s("address"),
        connected: b("connected"),
        status: s("status"),
        is_egress_gateway: b("isegressgateway"),
        egress_ranges: v
            .get("egressgatewayranges")
            .and_then(|x| x.as_array())
            .map(|a| {
                a.iter()
                    .filter_map(|r| r.as_str().map(str::to_string))
                    .collect()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default(),
    }
}

/// Map a raw Netmaker API egress object onto the typed [`EgressSummary`].
fn egress_summary_from_api(v: &JsonValue) -> EgressSummary {
    let s = |k: &str| v.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    EgressSummary {
        id: s("id"),
        name: s("name"),
        network: s("network"),
        range: s("range"),
        nat_type: s("nat_type"),
        mode: s("mode"),
        node_ids: v
            .get("nodes")
            .and_then(|x| x.as_object())
            .map(|o| o.keys().cloned().collect())
            .unwrap_or_default(),
    }
}

pub async fn dispatch_netmaker_method(method: &str, args: &JsonValue) -> Result<JsonValue> {
    let plugin = NetmakerPlugin::new(NetmakerConfig::default());
    match method {
        "join_network" => {
            let input: JoinNetworkInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid join_network arguments")?;
            let token = input.token.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
            plugin.join_network(&input.network, token).await?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(JoinNetworkOutput {
                network: input.network,
                interface: NETCLIENT_INTERFACE.to_string(),
                enrolled_with_token: !token.is_empty(),
            })?)
        }
        "leave_network" => {
            let input: LeaveNetworkInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid leave_network arguments")?;
            let was_default = NetmakerPlugin::read_netclient_config()
                .await
                .ok()
                .and_then(|c| {
                    c.get("default_network")
                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                        .map(|d| d == input.network)
                })
                .unwrap_or(false);
            plugin.leave_network(&input.network).await?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(LeaveNetworkOutput {
                network: input.network,
                was_default,
            })?)
        }
        "list_networks" => {
            let _input: ListNetworksInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid list_networks arguments")?;
            let raw = NetmakerPlugin::list_networks_api().await?;
            let networks = raw
                .as_array()
                .map(|a| a.iter().map(network_summary_from_api).collect())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(ListNetworksOutput { networks })?)
        }
        "list_nodes" => {
            let input: ListNodesInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid list_nodes arguments")?;
            let raw = NetmakerPlugin::list_nodes_api(&input.network).await?;
            let nodes = raw
                .as_array()
                .map(|a| a.iter().map(node_summary_from_api).collect())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(ListNodesOutput {
                network: input.network,
                nodes,
            })?)
        }
        "get_node" => {
            let input: GetNodeInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid get_node arguments")?;
            let raw = NetmakerPlugin::get_node_api(&input.network, &input.node_id).await?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(GetNodeOutput {
                node: node_summary_from_api(&raw),
            })?)
        }
        "update_node" => {
            let input: UpdateNodeInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid update_node arguments")?;
            let changed_fields = input
                .payload
                .as_object()
                .map(|o| o.keys().cloned().collect())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            let raw =
                NetmakerPlugin::update_node_api(&input.network, &input.node_id, &input.payload)
                    .await?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(UpdateNodeOutput {
                node: node_summary_from_api(&raw),
                changed_fields,
            })?)
        }
        "create_egress" => {
            let input: CreateEgressInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid create_egress arguments")?;
            let raw = NetmakerPlugin::create_egress_api(&input).await?;
            let body = raw.get("Response").unwrap_or(&raw);
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(CreateEgressOutput {
                egress: egress_summary_from_api(body),
            })?)
        }
        "delete_egress" => {
            let input: DeleteEgressInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid delete_egress arguments")?;
            NetmakerPlugin::delete_egress_api(&input.egress_id).await?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(DeleteEgressOutput {
                egress_id: input.egress_id,
            })?)
        }
        _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown netmaker method: {method}"),
    }
}
